name: apply_patch
description: The only file-editing tool: use it for creating, modifying, and deleting files. Wrap the patch in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch, containing one or more Add File / Update File / Delete File sections; a single patch can cover multiple files and multiple changes.

patchText.description: Full patch text. Format: *** Begin Patch; one or more file operations; *** End Patch. In Add File every content line must start with +; Update File uses @@ hunks with lines starting with a space, -, or +; Delete File removes the file.
